claim.hg: Rona sirf chhote bachchon ka kaam hai.

fact.en: Crying is not just for babies. Children cry. Grown-ups cry too. Tears help the body let out sad, hurt or angry feelings. Boys can cry and girls can cry. After crying, many people feel a little better. If you feel like crying, it is okay.
fact.hg: Rona sirf chhote bachchon ke liye nahi hai. Bachche rote hain. Bade bhi rote hain. Aansu body ko udaasi, dard ya gusse wali feelings bahar nikaalne mein help karte hain. Ladke ro sakte hain aur ladkiyan bhi ro sakti hain. Rone ke baad bahut se logon ko thoda halka lagta hai. Agar rone ka mann ho, toh rona theek hai.

why.en: Many children hear 'stop crying, be brave' from grown-ups who want them to feel better quickly. So crying starts to feel like something to hide.
why.hg: Bahut se bachche bade logon se 'rona band karo, brave bano' sunte hain, kyunki bade chahte hain ki bachcha jaldi better feel kare. Isliye rona chhupane wali cheez lagne lagta hai.

claim.en: People on social media really look the way they do in their photos.
claim.hg: Social media par log actually waise hi dikhte hain jaise apni photos mein.

fact.en: Most photos online are selected, posed and edited. Filters smooth skin, slim faces, change body shape and lighten skin tone, and lighting and angles do the rest. Influencers and advertisers may also use professional retouching. Comparing your everyday body with these images is comparing real life with a finished product.
fact.hg: Online zyadatar photos chuni hui, pose karke li gayi aur edited hoti hain. Filters skin smooth karte hain, face slim karte hain, body shape badalte hain aur rang gora kar dete hain, aur baaki kaam lighting aur angles kar dete hain. Influencers aur advertisers professional retouching bhi karwate hain. Apni roz ki body ko in images se compare karna real life ko ek finished product se compare karna hai.

why.en: The photos look casual, as if taken in a second, and we see hundreds of them every day. When edited images are everywhere, the brain starts treating them as normal.
why.hg: Yeh photos casual lagti hain, jaise ek second mein kheench li gayi hon, aur hum roz aisi saikdon photos dekhte hain. Jab edited images har jagah hon, toh dimaag unhe hi normal maanne lagta hai.

claim.en: Everyone my age is already in a relationship or having sex.
claim.hg: Meri age ka har koi already relationship mein hai ya sex kar raha hai.

fact.en: Many teenagers have never dated or had any sexual experience, and that is normal. People tend to overestimate what their peers are doing because the boldest stories get repeated and quiet people say nothing. In India, the law does not recognise consent to sexual activity below 18. Waiting is a common, valid choice.
fact.hg: Bahut se teenagers ne kabhi date nahi kiya aur unhe koi sexual experience nahi hai, aur yeh normal hai. Log aksar overestimate kar lete hain ki unke peers kya kar rahe hain, kyunki sabse bold stories repeat hoti hain aur chup rehne wale kuch nahi bolte. India mein law 18 se kam umar mein sexual activity ke liye consent ko nahi maanta. Wait karna ek common aur valid choice hai.

why.en: Films, reels and bragging friends show only one kind of story. Nobody posts 'nothing happened this year', so silence gets mistaken for being the odd one out.
why.hg: Films, reels aur deeng maarne wale friends ek hi tarah ki story dikhate hain. Koi yeh post nahi karta ki 'is saal kuch nahi hua', isliye chup rehne wale ko lagta hai ki wahi akela odd one out hai.

claim.en: Asking someone if they are thinking about suicide will put the idea in their head.
claim.hg: Kisi se poochhna ki kya woh suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, uske dimaag mein yeh idea daal dega.

fact.en: Asking calmly and directly does not plant the idea. It often brings relief, because the person no longer has to hide what they feel, and it opens the door to help. Listen, take it seriously, stay with them and connect them to a trusted adult, Tele-MANAS on 14416, or 112 in an emergency.
fact.hg: Calmly aur directly poochhne se yeh idea plant nahi hota. Isse aksar relief milta hai, kyunki us insaan ko ab apni feeling chhupani nahi padti, aur help ka raasta khulta hai. Suno, baat ko seriously lo, uske saath raho aur usse kisi trusted adult, Tele-MANAS 14416, ya emergency mein 112 se connect karo.

why.en: Suicide is frightening and rarely discussed openly at home or in school, so people worry that naming it is dangerous. Staying silent feels safer, even though it leaves the person alone.
why.hg: Suicide darane wala topic hai aur ghar ya school mein is par khulkar baat kam hi hoti hai, isliye logon ko lagta hai ki iska naam lena hi dangerous hai. Chup rehna zyada safe lagta hai, jabki isse woh insaan akela pad jaata hai.

claim.en: Jealousy and checking your phone show how much someone loves you.
claim.hg: Jealousy aur tumhara phone check karna dikhata hai ki koi tumse kitna pyaar karta hai.

fact.en: Feeling jealous now and then is human. Acting on it by checking your phone, demanding passwords, tracking your location or deciding whom you can talk to is control, not love. Care looks like trust and respect for your privacy and friendships. Monitoring that leaves you anxious or isolated is a warning sign of emotional abuse.
fact.hg: Kabhi-kabhar jealous feel karna human hai. Lekin us jealousy mein phone check karna, passwords maangna, location track karna ya yeh decide karna ki tum kisse baat karoge, control hai, pyaar nahi. Care ka matlab hai trust aur tumhari privacy aur friendships ki respect. Aisi monitoring jo tumhe anxious ya akela kar de, emotional abuse ka warning sign hai.

why.en: Films and songs often present possessive lovers as romantic and devoted. When 'I cannot bear you talking to anyone else' is shown as passion, control can be mistaken for caring.
why.hg: Films aur gaane aksar possessive lovers ko romantic aur devoted dikhate hain. Jab 'main tumhe kisi aur se baat karte nahi dekh sakta' ko passion bataya jaata hai, toh control ko caring samajh liya jaata hai.

claim.en: Stress and worry can cause real physical symptoms like stomach aches and headaches.
claim.hg: Stress aur tension se pet dard aur sirdard jaise real physical symptoms ho sakte hain.

fact.en: True. The brain and body are closely linked. When you are stressed, the body releases stress hormones that tighten muscles, speed up the heart and affect digestion and sleep. That is why exam worry can cause a stomach ache, headache or nausea. The pain is real, not 'acting'. If symptoms keep returning, see a doctor and also talk about the stress.
fact.hg: Sach hai. Dimaag aur body aapas mein closely linked hain. Stress mein body stress hormones release karti hai jo muscles tight kar dete hain, heartbeat tez karte hain aur digestion aur neend par asar daalte hain. Isiliye exam ki tension se pet dard, sirdard ya nausea ho sakta hai. Dard real hai, 'acting' nahi. Agar symptoms baar-baar lautein, toh doctor ko dikhao aur stress ke baare mein bhi baat karo.

why.en: People often separate 'mind problems' from 'body problems', so a child with a stomach ache before school may be told they are making excuses.
why.hg: Log aksar 'mann ki problem' aur 'body ki problem' ko alag-alag maante hain, isliye school se pehle pet dard batane wale bachche ko bol diya jaata hai ki woh bahane bana raha hai.

claim.en: Social media is bad for your mental health.
claim.hg: Social media mental health ke liye bura hai.

fact.en: It depends on how you use it. Hours of scrolling and comparing yourself with edited lives, losing sleep to the phone, or facing online bullying are linked with feeling worse. Using it to stay in touch with friends, find supportive communities or learn can help. Watch how you feel after using an app, and adjust: mute, unfollow, set time limits.
fact.hg: Yeh is par depend karta hai ki tum isse kaise use karte ho. Ghanton scroll karna aur edited zindagiyon se apna comparison karna, phone ki wajah se neend khona, ya online bullying jhelna, yeh sab bura feel karne se linked hain. Friends se touch mein rehne, supportive communities dhundhne ya kuch seekhne ke liye iska use help kar sakta hai. Notice karo ki kisi app ke baad kaisa feel hota hai, aur usi hisaab se adjust karo: mute, unfollow, time limits.

why.en: Adults often blame the phone for every teenage problem, while many young people feel their online friendships are real and valuable. Both sides are describing part of the picture.
why.hg: Bade aksar teenagers ki har problem ka blame phone par daal dete hain, jabki bahut se young logon ko apni online friendships real aur valuable lagti hain. Dono sides picture ka ek-ek hissa bata rahe hain.

claim.en: Eating disorders only happen to thin teenage girls from rich families.
claim.hg: Eating disorders sirf ameer families ki patli teenage ladkiyon ko hote hain.

fact.en: Eating disorders affect boys, men, women and non-binary people, at every body size, income level and age, though they often begin in the teens. Many people who are seriously ill look 'normal' or live in larger bodies, and boys are often missed because nobody expects it. What defines the illness is fear, secrecy and loss of control around food and weight, not how someone looks.
fact.hg: Eating disorders ladkon, men, women aur non-binary logon ko, har body size, har income level aur har age mein ho sakte hain, haalanki yeh aksar teens mein shuru hote hain. Seriously ill bahut se log 'normal' dikhte hain ya unki body badi hoti hai, aur ladke aksar miss ho jaate hain kyunki kisi ko unme iski expectation nahi hoti. Is illness ki pehchaan khane aur weight ko lekar darr, secrecy aur control kho dena hai, yeh nahi ki koi kaisa dikhta hai.

why.en: Films, news stories and health posters have mostly shown very thin young women, so that picture became the definition. Families and even doctors can then overlook the same illness in a boy or in someone who is not thin.
why.hg: Films, news stories aur health posters mein zyadatar bahut patli young women hi dikhayi gayi hain, isliye wahi picture iski definition ban gayi. Phir families aur kabhi-kabhi doctors bhi kisi ladke mein ya kisi aise insaan mein, jo patla nahi hai, wahi illness overlook kar dete hain.

claim.en: Fathers can get depressed after a baby is born too.
claim.hg: Bacche ke janm ke baad fathers ko bhi depression ho sakta hai.

fact.en: True. Postnatal depression is best known in mothers, where it affects a significant minority, but new fathers can develop it as well, especially with broken sleep, money worries, a partner who is unwell or little support. In men it may look like irritability, withdrawal or overwork instead of tears. It is treatable in both parents, and treating it also helps the baby. See a doctor or call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
fact.hg: Sahi. Postnatal depression mothers mein zyada jaana jata hai, jahan yeh ek significant minority ko hota hai, par naye fathers ko bhi ho sakta hai, khaaskar tooti neend, paise ki tension, partner ki kharab tabiyat ya support ki kami ke saath. Men mein yeh aansuon ki jagah chidchidepan, withdrawal ya overwork ke roop mein dikh sakta hai. Dono parents mein yeh treatable hai, aur treatment se bacche ko bhi fayda hota hai. Doctor ko dikhao ya Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karo.

why.en: It surprises people because pregnancy and birth happen in the mother's body and fathers are expected to be the strong provider. Many men do not realise that what they feel has a name.
why.hg: Logon ko ispe surprise hota hai kyunki pregnancy aur delivery maa ki body mein hoti hai aur father se strong provider bane rehne ki expectation hoti hai. Bahut se men ko pata hi nahi hota ki woh jo feel kar rahe hain uska ek naam hai.
